manual.item_router.line1: Left foot yellow, right hand green
manual.item_router.line2: {0}The Item Router is designed to parcel and sort items into inventories such as chests, machines, and {1}conveyors{2}.{3}
manual.item_router.line3: Items inserted into the router will be output from matching configured sides or open sides in that order.{0}
manual.item_router.line4: Items can be inserted from any side, and will be output from one of the other five sides, or will disallow input if they cannot be sorted.{0}
manual.item_router.line5: Routers will extract from routers and inventories they are connected to when they are extracted from themselves.{0}
manual.item_router.line6: Colors match to a cardinal direction and a set of filters the router will sort with.{0}
manual.item_router.line7: The buttons above each filter can be used to further adjust how the filter works:{0}
manual.item_router.line8: §2Tag-based filtering§r allows items through the filter if they match a tag of the specified item. The specific tag can be selected with the scroll-wheel. This can be used to filter ingots, ores or other items with similar properties together.{0}
manual.item_router.line9: The §2Damage filter§r option allows the filter to ignore the damage value of a tool or weapon.{0}
manual.item_router.line10: The §2Components filter§r option allows respecting additional, special properties of the item, such as enchantments or color.
